Service Requirements The Contractor must provide printing services, including the following tasks: • Graphic design and creation of annual report content for various Embassy offices. • Graphic design and creation of brochures, information portfolios, folders, advertising publications, flyers, and similar materials for the Embassy's promotional events. • Printing and/or photocopying of documents, brochures, and portfolios in a professional manner, ensuring clear colors, photographs, text, and images for finished products. Preference will be given to contractors offering multiple printing methods, such as commercial, digital, press, and web-based printing. • Supplying stock images for publications, as needed. • Providing printing designs for requesting offices to review and confirm prior to production. The Contractor is responsible for installing, setting up, and delivering printed items to U.S. Embassy Hanoi events. • Material Requirements: The Contractor shall present several material options for the Embassy's selection prior to submitting a quote. Services must include all necessary supplies — such as equipment, toner, developer, fuser agent, staples, paper, g

US-Hyperscaler sind als primäre Hosting-Plattform ausge- schlossen. Für die Verarbeitung von Sozialdaten gemäß SGB V ist besondere Sorgfalt anzu- wenden (§§ 67 ff. SGB X). Alle eingesetzten Drittdienste sind auf EU-konformes Hosting zu prüfen. Bei Nutzung von Cloud-Diensten sind zusätzlich die gesetzlichen Vorgaben nach § 393 SGB V zur Verarbeitung von Sozial- und Gesundheitsdaten in der Cloud zu erfüllen. Hierzu zählen insbesondere ein zulässiger Verarbeitungsstandort, die Niederlassung der datenverarbeiten- den Stelle in Deutschland sowie ein aktuelles C5-Typ-2-Testat gemäß § 393 SGB V oder die Vorlage eines Maßnahmenplanes inkl. Meilensteinplanung, der vorsieht innerhalb von 24 Monaten ab Erstellung des Maßnahmenplanes ein C5-Typ2-Testat zu erhalten. Sofern Cloud-Dienste zum Einsatz kommen, sind diese Vorgaben vom Hosting-Anbieter (auch als Unterauftragnehmer) ebenfalls zu erfüllen und nachzuweisen. Der für die Leistung relevante Scope des Testats ist einzubeziehen und nachzuweisen. Le besoin vise la recherche et le développement de capacités C4ISR de nouvelle génération afin d'améliorer la connaissance de la situation et la prise de décision dans des opérations militaires multi-domaines (terre, air, mer, espace, cyber et information). Les travaux porteront sur l'intégration et l'exploitation de données provenant de sources variées en utilisant l'intelligence artificielle, l'apprentissage automatique et la fusion de données multimodales. L'objectif est de concevoir des systèmes agiles, adaptatifs et reconfigurables capables de s'ajuster rapidement à l'évolution des missions et des menaces, tout en maintenant la supervision humaine. Les activités comprendront la conception de cadres conceptuels C4ISR, le développement d'outils d'intégration, d'analyse et de visualisation des données, la recherche sur la fusion de capteurs basée sur l'IA, l'adaptation des c

During a period of extended Leave Without Pay (LWOP) or other unpaid leave beyond one pay period, the employee is responsible for the full cost of the insurance premiums for self and dependents. The Mission will pay the premiums directly to the Contractor and will collect the full cost from the employee on a quarterly basis. Alternatively

Introduction The Administrative Office of the United States Courts (AO) is seeking contractor services for the printing and mailing of the following Internal Revenue Service (IRS) information returns: • W-2, Wage and Tax Statement • 1099-R, Distributions from Pensions, Annuities, Retirement or Profit-Sharing Plans, IRAs, Insurance Contracts, etc. • 1099-INT, Interest Income • 1099-MISC, Miscellaneous Income • 1099-NEC Nonemployee Compensation The printing and mailing support service will allow the Federal Judiciary to accomplish the requirement on the annual IRS tax reporting obligations. This contract will be for printing and mailing services ONLY and DOES NOT include the contractor providing any other tax-related services. The AO will provide ready-to-print and mail Portable Document File (PDF) data files to the contractor with all W-2 and 1099 boxes prepopulated with the appropriate tax information along with appropriate instructions of each tax form. nited States (OCONUS), as well as to U.S. territories and USCA27R0019 - Page 10 of 29 international addresses as provided by the judiciary. The contractor shall provide the judiciary with electronic copies of all W-2s and 1099s printed and mailed to the recipients. The contractor must have the capability to securely receive and store electronic files from the AO using AO approved encryption methods such as Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) for files in-transit and hard disk encryption for files at-rest. The contractor shall make available their secure file system for remote AO security testing and inspection by the AO DCIO Information Assurance Branch immediately after award, and prior to any work performed under this contract. In the event the contractor’s system is deemed incapable of performance, and the contractor is unable to fully comply with the requirements to securely receive and store electronic files from the AO, the results shall be relayed to the AO Department of Administrative Services (DAS) Acquisition Management Office (AMO) for potential contract action, to include immediate termination.
